 AIIMS INI CET Admit Card 2026 Download at aiimsexams.ac.in: Hall Ticket Releasing October 26, Check Direct Link and Steps
 Updated on
October 25, 2026 
 By
 Manoj Kulkarni 
 Share 
 Tweet 
 The AIIMS INI CET Admit Card 2026 for the January 2027 session is set to be released on October 26, 2026 . The All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, will issue the hall tickets through its official website, aiimsexams.ac.in .
 Candidates can download the INI CET January 2027 admit card using their registration ID and password. However, the download link has not opened as of October 25, 2026.
 The INI CET November 2026 exam will take place on November 1, 2026 , in computer-based test (CBT) mode. Therefore, students should download their admit cards as soon as the link becomes active.

 AIIMS INI CET Admit Card 2026: Latest Updates
 AIIMS will release the hall tickets online for the January 2027 admission session. The admit card will show key details, such as the exam centre and reporting time.
 Also, candidates should check the instructions printed on their hall tickets. These rules will help them plan their exam day.
 Particulars Details 
 Exam name Institute of National Importance Combined Entrance Test 
 Short name INI CET 
 Conducting body AIIMS New Delhi 
 Admission session January 2027 
 Admit card release date October 26, 2026 
 Admit card status Not released as of October 25 
 Exam date November 1, 2026 
 Exam mode Computer-based test 
 Login details Registration ID and password 
 Official website aiimsexams.ac.in 
 Important: The exact admit card release time has not been shared in the reference. Candidates should check the official portal for updates.
 AIIMS INI CET Admit Card 2026 Direct Download Link
 The INI CET admit card download link will be available through the AIIMS examination website. Once released, candidates must log in to view their hall tickets.
 AIIMS will not send admit cards by post. Therefore, candidates must download and print their own copies.
 Official admit card portal: https://www.aiimsexams.ac.in/ 
 Download link status: Awaited as of October 25, 2026.
 The direct candidate login URL was not provided in the reference. However, candidates can reach the login page through the Academic Courses section on the official website.
 How to Download AIIMS INI CET Admit Card 2026?
 The INI CET January 2027 hall ticket will be available through candidate login. Students should keep their login details ready before opening the website.
 Also, they should use a stable internet connection. This will help avoid errors during the download process.
 Follow these steps:
 Visit aiimsexams.ac.in .
 Open the Academic Courses section.
 Select INI CET from the course list.
 Click the candidate login link.
 Enter your registration ID.
 Type your password and CAPTCHA code.
 Submit the login details.
 Open the INI CET January 2027 Admit Card .
 Download the hall ticket PDF.
 Finally, print a clear copy for exam day.
 Candidates should save a digital copy as well. However, they must carry a printed admit card to the exam centre.
 Details to Check on INI CET November 2026 Hall Ticket
 After downloading the admit card, candidates should check every detail. Wrong details may cause problems during entry or identity checks.
 First, check your name and photograph. Next, check the exam centre address and reporting time.
 The admit card may include:
 Candidate’s name and registration number.
 Roll number.
 Photograph and other identity details.
 Exam date and time.
 Exam centre name and address.
 Reporting and entry times.
 Exam day instructions.
 If any detail is wrong, candidates should contact AIIMS through its official support channel. Also, they should not make changes to the printed admit card.
 INI CET January 2027 Exam Date and Pattern
 The INI CET 2026 exam date for the January 2027 session is November 1, 2026 . AIIMS will conduct the test online at exam centres across India.
 The entrance exam is used for admission to postgraduate medical courses at participating institutes. These include eligible MD, MS, MDS and other courses covered by INI CET.
 Exam Detail Information 
 Exam date November 1, 2026 
 Mode Computer-based test 
 Admission session January 2027 
 Test centre As shown on admit card 
 Reporting time As shown on admit card 
 Candidates must follow the exam pattern and marking rules given in the official AIIMS prospectus. The supplied reference does not confirm any new change to the exam pattern.
 INI CET 2026 Exam Day Guidelines
 The INI CET admit card 2026 is a must-have document for the exam. Candidates who fail to bring it may not be allowed to enter the centre.
 Also, students should plan their journey in advance. Reaching the centre early will give them enough time for identity checks.
 Follow these important rules:
 Carry a clear printed copy of the admit card.
 Bring a valid photo ID as required by AIIMS.
 Reach the exam centre before the reporting deadline.
 Check the centre address before exam day.
 Follow the dress and item rules in the hall ticket.
 Do not carry banned electronic devices.
 Follow all instructions given by exam staff.
 Note: The hall ticket will provide the final rules for exam day. Candidates must read them with care.
 What If the INI CET Admit Card 2026 Does Not Download?
 Some candidates may face login or download errors when the link opens. However, many basic issues can be checked before seeking help.
 First, confirm that you entered the correct registration ID and password. Next, check the CAPTCHA code and try again.
 If the page does not load, refresh it or try an updated browser. Also, check your internet connection.
 If you forget your password, use the recovery option if it is available. For other problems, contact AIIMS through the help details listed on its official website.
 Never share your password or login details with an unknown person.
 AIIMS INI CET Admit Card 2026: FAQs
 1. When will AIIMS release the INI CET admit card 2026? 
 The admit card is scheduled for October 26, 2026 .
 2. Is the INI CET January 2027 admit card out? 
 No. As of October 25, 2026, the admit card is not yet released.
 3. What is the INI CET November 2026 exam date? 
 The exam will take place on November 1, 2026 .
 4. What details are needed to download the admit card? 
 Candidates need their registration ID, password and CAPTCHA code.
 5. Can I enter the exam centre without an admit card? 
 No. Candidates must carry a printed hall ticket and follow the exam centre’s identity check rules.
 What Should INI CET Candidates Do Next?
 Candidates should keep their registration details ready for the INI CET admit card release on October 26 .
 After downloading the hall ticket, they should check their exam centre, date and reporting time. Moreover, they should print the admit card and prepare the required photo ID.
 For the latest notices, visit the AIIMS examination website .
